syllabus.title: Practice Test 05 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• Center of Mass and System of Particles (Complete)
• Rotational Motion (Moment of Inertia only)
• Basic Maths and Calculus (Complete)

📌 CHEMISTRY
• Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties: (Complete Chapter)
• Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure: Introduction,Ionic or Electrovalent Bond, Lattice Energy
• Kössel - Lewis Approach to Chemical Bonding
• Kössel - Lewis Approach to Chemical Bonding,Formal Charge
• Valence Bond Theory , hybridisation,
• Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion (VSEPR) Theory

📌 BOTANY
• Morphology of Flowering Plants (Complete Chapter)
• Anatomy of Flowering Plants (Complete Chapter)

📌 ZOOLOGY
• Neural Control and Coordination (Complete Chapter)
